fusions.name: Gauntlet Rap
fusions.desc: A hard rap that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrecking Crash
fusions.desc: Crashes down on every enemy within 3 tiles; each hit deals 28 damage. It also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Bulwark Stance
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage, up to 5 blows, for 10 seconds and raises your armour by 15%.

fusions.name: Cold Ballast
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 14%, and your physical resistance rises by 10%.
